Explore the Android MusicPlayer project at c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer. I need to understand:

2. Find the layout files - especially the main activity layout, Now Playing screen layout, and any files that handle status bar / window insets
3. Find the NowPlayingFragment or NowPlayingActivity file
4. Find any files related to window insets, status bar padding, or edge-to-edge display

Return the file paths for:
- The main activity XML layout
- The Now Playing screen layout XML
- The NowPlayingFragment/Activity Kotlin/Java file
- Any theme or style files

Exploring the project structure and searching for layouts, Now Playing components, and window-insets-related code.

[REDACTED]

Here is a concise map of the **MusicPlayer** project based on exploration under `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer`.

## 1. Overall structure (key areas)

| Area | Path / note |
|------|-------------|
| **Root Gradle** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\build.gradle.kts`, `settings.gradle.kts`, `gradle.properties` |
| **App module** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\` |
| **App Gradle** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\build.gradle.kts` |
| **Manifest** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\AndroidManifest.xml` |
| **Kotlin source** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\` |
| **UI (Compose)** | `.../ui/screens/*`, `.../ui/navigation/`, `.../ui/components/`, `.../ui/theme/` |
| **Service / playback** | `.../service/` |
| **Data** | `.../data/` |
| **Resources** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\res\` — **no `res/layout/`** (0 layout XML files in the repo) |

The UI is **Jetpack Compose** end-to-end; there are **no traditional View-based `activity_*.xml` / fragment layouts**.

---

## 2. Layout XML files (main activity & Now Playing)

**There is no main activity XML layout and no Now Playing XML layout.**  
`MainActivity` uses `setContent { ... }` and navigation/screens are composables, not XML.

Equivalent “where the UI is defined”:

- **Main shell**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\MainActivity.kt`
- **Root navigation + bottom bar / inset padding for `NavHost`**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\navigation\AppNavigation.kt`
- **Now Playing UI**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\nowplaying\NowPlayingScreen.kt`

---

## 3. NowPlayingFragment / NowPlayingActivity

**Neither exists.** Now Playing is implemented as:

- **`NowPlayingScreen` composable**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\nowplaying\NowPlayingScreen.kt`
- **`NowPlayingViewModel`**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\nowplaying\NowPlayingViewModel.kt`
- **Related sheet**: `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\nowplaying\SleepTimerSheet.kt`

The **single activity** is `MainActivity` (see manifest).

---

## 4. Window insets, status bar, edge-to-edge

| Concern | File(s) |
|--------|---------|
| **Edge-to-edge** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\MainActivity.kt` — calls `enableEdgeToEdge()` |
| **Transparent system bars (XML)** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\res\values\themes.xml` — `statusBarColor`, `navigationBarColor`, `windowDrawsSystemBarBackgrounds`, `windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode` |
| **Compose `Scaffold` insets** | **Root**: `AppNavigation.kt` uses `contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets.safeDrawing` on the outer `Scaffold`, and `NavHost` uses `Modifier.padding(innerPadding)`. **Per-screen** `Scaffold`s (including Now Playing) use `contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0)` so inset handling is mostly at the root. |

Files under `app\src\main` that reference **`WindowInsets` / `contentWindowInsets`**:

- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\navigation\AppNavigation.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\nowplaying\NowPlayingScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\home\HomeScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\library\LibraryScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\playlist\PlaylistScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\settings\SettingsScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\equalizer\EqualizerScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\albumdetail\AlbumDetailScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\artistdetail\ArtistDetailScreen.kt`
- `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\screens\fileexplorer\FileExplorerScreen.kt`

**`fitSystemWindows`**: no matches anywhere in the project (Compose does not use this View attribute).

---

## Requested file paths (checklist)

| Item | Path |
|------|------|
| **Main activity XML layout** | **None** — UI is Compose in `MainActivity.kt` |
| **Now Playing screen layout XML** | **None** — UI is `NowPlayingScreen.kt` |
| **NowPlaying Fragment/Activity** | **None** — use `NowPlayingScreen.kt` + `NowPlayingViewModel.kt` |
| **Theme / style (XML)** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\res\values\themes.xml` |
| **Compose theme (Material 3)** | `c:\Users\udays\OneDrive\Documents\Work\Android_Apps\MusicPlayer\app\src\main\java\com\musicplayer\ui\theme\Theme.kt`, `Color.kt`, `Type.kt` |
| **`windowInsets` / Scaffold insets** | `MainActivity.kt` (`enableEdgeToEdge`), `AppNavigation.kt` (`WindowInsets.safeDrawing`), screen `Scaffold`s including `NowPlayingScreen.kt` (`WindowInsets(0)`) |
| **`fitSystemWindows`** | **No files** — not used |

---

**Takeaway:** This app is a **single-Activity Compose** app with **no XML layouts** for main or Now Playing screens. System bar and cutout behavior are configured in **`themes.xml`** and **`enableEdgeToEdge()`**, with **safe drawing insets applied on the root `Scaffold` in `AppNavigation.kt`**, not via XML `fitSystemWindows`.
